The low nibble of a cell selects its block type through the table at $073E. Every cell is zero except column 1 ($01), column 3 ($01), column 6 ($80). Cell 1 translates to type 2, the closed door that OPEN and CLOSE change through the replacement tables at $071E and $072E.

192 bytes ($0640-$06FF) after the 64-cell strip, all zero except $06FE ($80), which has the same value as the strip cell in column 6. The position mask $5E is $FF in this scene ($59A1 indexed by header byte $0705 = 0), so columns 64 to 255 reach these bytes; whether the scene's bounds keep the player inside the first 64 columns was not checked.

Start of the 32-byte scene header that the loader at $557A unpacks after the map. The bytes are $50 34 2D 2D 00 00 00 00 0C 0F 09 09 09 09 55 34. Every nibble maps to itself except 1, which becomes 4 (type 7 through the cell-type table); the overlay overrides the table result with 2 or 3 in phase 1 of the Alph and Ralph conversation.

Sixteen low-nibble-to-type values read indexed by the resident at $351E, $3565, $3B5A (in $3B51), $4192 (in $4173), $4A8E, $4B27, $4F7D, $4F99, $4FE8 and $503E. Bytes: 00 02 07 07 07 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01. Nibble 0 is type 0, nibble 1 is type 2 (the closed door), nibbles 2 to 4 are type 7, and nibbles 5 to 15 are type 1. The map strip uses only cells 0, 1 and $80 (low nibble 0).

Sixteen inclusive upper column bounds read by $4115 (bytes: 01 03 07 FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF). Resident $411C takes the first entry whose bound is at least the coarse column in $AF, so columns 0 to 1 select region 0, up to 3 region 1, up to 7 region 2, and any further column region 3 (the fourth bound is $FF).

Sixteen zero bytes ($075E-$076D) between the column thresholds and the selectors. The scan at $411C reads at most index 14 ($075C), so it reads none of them; the resident routine $38FE (update_grid_special_cell) reads and writes $075E,Y (at $3901/$3915), and $381C increments $075E,X, with Y the low nibble of a special map cell, so any scene whose map has such cells uses these bytes as per-cell state.

Sixteen source selectors, one per region (bytes: 02 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00). Resident $412B reads the one for the region found at $411C: 0 uses the region itself as the table index (bank 0), 1 takes bits $60 of the state byte $0500, 2 takes bits $60 of $0501, and 3 or more take bits $60 of the shared PRNG.
